row.evidence: GoTo's support centre says admins can provision through Okta, Microsoft Entra, OneLogin or Google Workspace, or build their own with "the SCIM APIs and Administration REST APIs"; the pricing page lists Single Sign-On and the Active Directory Connector on every plan, and no plan gate on SCIM is documented.
row.notes: Status is free on the absence of any documented plan gate: the pricing page (Professional, Business, Enterprise) marks Single Sign-On, Admin Center and Active Directory Connector on all plans, and the provisioning docs only require an Organization Center organization with a verified domain. Dollar amounts on the pricing page are filled in by JavaScript and could not be read (Akamai 403 to curl; renderer blocked). Provisioning goes through GoTo's identity platform (LogMeIn parent app in Okta and OneLogin, GoTo gallery app in Entra, GoToMeeting autoprovisioning in Google Workspace); IdP deactivation suspends the user and removes roles and product access, while SCIM DELETE removes the user from the organization but not the account. Okta also lists a third-party GoTo Meeting by Aquera connector and an SWA-only GoToMeeting app. Admin REST API covers users, groups, licences and role sets.

operations.notes: PUT (Replace User) and PATCH (Update User) both documented on /Users/{userKey}; deactivate/reactivate behaviour from the Okta guide.

deprovision.data_retained: User remains in the GoTo account with Suspended status; account role and product access removed. SCIM DELETE removes the user from the organization but not from the account.

filtering.notes: Users: eq and sw only. Groups: displayName with eq, sw, co.

attributes.notes: externalId, active and enterprise-extension attributes come from the Entra attribute mapping table.

limitations.text: Requires an organization in the GoTo Organization Center with a verified email domain.

auth.notes: OAuth user access token with identity: scope; personal access tokens also supported; calls need admin roles such as ROLE_EXT_ADMIN_MANAGE_USERS.

okta.notes: Provisioning uses the LogMeIn parent app (OIN lists SAML, SWA, SCIM with Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push). The separate GoToMeeting OIN app is SWA only (c40), and 'GoTo Meeting by Aquera' is a third-party connector (c41).

google.notes: Google Workspace autoprovisioning app for GoToMeeting; Google does not state the protocol or who built the connector.

onelogin.notes: From GoTo's own OneLogin guide (LogMeIn app); OneLogin catalogue not checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: Active Directory Connector v2 (GoTo-built AD sync tool)

open_questions: Plan prices on the GoTo Meeting pricing page could not be read (JavaScript-filled; Akamai blocks curl, renderer refused).
No GoTo page states which plan includes SCIM/IdP provisioning; free status rests on absence of a gate plus SSO and AD Connector on all plans.
SCIM version not stated (spec cites the SCIM core schema draft); rate limits, token lifetime and whether suspension frees the licence are undocumented.
Whether the Google Workspace GoToMeeting app uses SCIM and who built the Okta LogMeIn app are not stated; JumpCloud not checked.
